title: Governed autonomous Staging watcher continuity, acceptance and bounded self-healing

phases.objective: Deliver repository-tested, fail-closed Staging-only supervisor policy and allowlisted recovery while requiring independent live Staging evidence before operational acceptance.

e2e_journeys.actor: MAD4B Staging operator and Windows scheduled-task supervisor
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Additive Staging task installation and existing Auto Deploy watcher, verified by Windows PowerShell fixture CI and a Node cross-platform governance check.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The supervisor accepts only fresh exact-SHA Staging evidence and paired watcher cycles, starts only an unchanged authorized task within a durable retry budget, and preserves an unmet live Staging acceptance gate until host evidence exists.
steps: Inspect Staging-only policy, existing Windows task lifecycle wiring, and independent operational acceptance certificate contract.
Run the cross-platform governance contract and existing Windows PowerShell 5.1 fixture scenarios, including negative SHA, missing cycles, corrupt retry history and forbidden task identity.
Verify code cannot infer runtime content attestation from a health snapshot and cannot mutate Production, SQL, DNS or provider authority.
Require separately evidenced live host task readback, restart behavior and immutable runtime integrity attestation before real Staging operational sign-off.
assertions: Only the exact allowlisted Windows scheduled task can be started; new task identities or executable-path drift are blocked.
The recovery budget is durable, bounded and fail-closed on corrupt data.
A valid two-poll/two-sleep count without ordered pair evidence is insufficient.
Production/provider/database/secret mutation remains false and independent runtime integrity is not attested by this supervisor.
live_staging_certification_required=true is a requirement, not a claim that acceptance has already passed.
